General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Bolt Kit for the Outer Timing Belt Cover for the Suzuki Samurai G13A & G13BA 1.3 Liter / 8 Valve Engines.
This kit will also fit the Geo Tracker and Suzuki Sidekick G16A 1.6 Liter / 8 Valve Engines.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Bolt
Qty 3 – Bolt
Qty 1 – Bolt
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
